Cloud Chasing E-liquid: These Fantasi Ice vape e-liquids are a 70/30 blend. When you vape a high VG e-juice, you can expect the best flavour and the most satisfying cloud creation with each puff.
Personalised Vaping Experience: All of our 120ml e-liquid short fills contain no nicotine, which gives our customers the flexibility to add nicotine shots or salts to create the vape strength of their desire.
Cost-effective: Fantasi liquid vape is specifically designed for clean vaping; this prevents coil burning and helps extend the lifespan of your vaping device, ultimately reducing your overall e-cigarette expenses.
Device Compatibility: To make your vaping experience easier, we manufacture our e-liquids with a 70vg/30pg ratio to assure compatibility with a wide range of Sub-Ohm vaping devices and vape kits.
Exemplary Quality: Fantasi vape liquids are manufactured in the UK in a cutting-edge ISO 7 clean room and supplied in Chubby Gorilla V3 Unicorn leak-proof dropper bottles. Better still, our e-liquids are produced in accordance with the strict guidelines set by GMP.
